judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service,normal canonical reports,command traces and source-bound evidence. No synthetic observation overlay is supplied. This stage starts from the real uninstrumented fixture. Perform the normal read-only audit and canonical findings/acceptance handoff. Missing SDK/log export and owned propagation requirements are real source gaps;do not invent received records or modify the application. The paired worker scenario is a future acceptance check,not executed instrumentation proof.

For positive implementation/verification,inspect raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof evidence,actual stdout/stderr and exact received span/log joins from the unchanged host checker. The independent pipeline also reruns that checker;self-reported success alone is insufficient.

Return exactly one check per criterion with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-14. Keep unselected/unsupported and unexecuted cases honest;do not require optional app features solely because a reference mentions them.

Studio live telemetry is intentionally evicted when the producer exits. The unchanged host checker captures its exact SDK log/span joins and native-count snapshot while the app is alive, then proves bounded owned-process cleanup. Live capture and cleanup do not establish post-exit persistence or final-record SDK drain; those require separate selected receipt evidence. Do not classify expected explorer eviction as missing application wiring.
rubric: Uses the requested loaded skill against the actual service and its current state. Distinguishes source/config/default evidence from executed telemetry;does not use imagined overlay observations or fabricated outcomes. This stage starts from the real uninstrumented fixture. Perform the normal read-only audit and canonical findings/acceptance handoff. Missing SDK/log export and owned propagation requirements are real source gaps;do not invent received records or modify the application. The paired worker scenario is a future acceptance check,not executed instrumentation proof. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed. Determine scenario AND item proof modes from the actual path, not audit proof_level, package/test filename or suite command: isolated in-memory SDK/bridge proof is unit; decoded loopback SDK export is unit+otlp; an actual application-owned helper/setup test can legitimately be app_test; full_runtime requires the claimed normal application path. Do not map every focused scenario to app_test or every item to full_runtime. Item mode describes its direct assertion scope: actual runtime proof can legitimately coexist with clearly scoped ancillary focused/incomplete scenarios. Do not fail merely because those are attached; fail an unsupported combined claim or mechanical first-scenario mode/visibility that misrepresents the item evidence.

Preserve canonical audit/selection bindings, immutable IDs/source and read-only boundaries. Audit plans; instrumentation implements authorized scope; verification proves current behavior without editing/rebinding the audit. Before finalizing a new audit's IDs or an instrumentation plan without an audit, decompose each selected repair promise by signal, setting/mode, input branch, deciding authority and required producer. Include procedural required_fix promises, telemetry fields, event order and selected source/policy controls; bind each to an addressable assertion and feasible observation boundary. The required-controls helper inventories telemetry promises, not all applicable source clauses. Grouped/parameterized cases are valid when individually addressable. Derive scenario/item verdicts and visibility from their own evidence; aggregate success, copied acceptance, helper syntax or a related pass cannot close missing controls. Direct item proof may coexist with incomplete ancillary scenarios, but cannot support a broader claim. Keep unmatched required controls Not proven.

Scope configuration coverage to app-owned/new overrides, supplied selected settings, requirements necessary to application/operator invariants, and every actual capability/default claim at its claimed scope. A versioned delegated default is a source fact, not a promise of every input variant or runtime conformance. Include dependent Resource, propagation/sampling, bridge/provider activation, filtering/SDK-disabled, selected limits and lifecycle behavior. Mere transitive SDK consumption does not require enumerating/testing every unused upstream setting. Ordinary delegated defaults may retain precise versioned source/default dispositions. This cannot excuse ignored operator values, false exact claims or an unresolved critical invariant.

For required settings, independently identify the actual public option or selected operator/environment reader and effective consumption. Follow precise claims through conversion, precedence, sentinel/default translation, units, validation/clamps and terminal consumer; resolve accessible delegates. Required casing, empty/unset, invalid, numeric/fractional/range/overflow, enum/no-op and higher-priority/fallback cases come from inputs that actually reach that selected reader or the precise behavior claimed. Fixed typed options instead need their applied value, units, native API, startup wiring and operator-preservation assertions; constants alone do not select every malformed SDK permutation. Do not excuse ignored active inputs or false fallback claims. Keep unresolved reader/wiring boundaries explicit, distinct owners/defaults/diagnostics separate, and native APIs distinct from serialized representations. Named controls across existing related scenarios may satisfy a selected profile when every setting/assertion and required execution boundary is addressable; a helper or different-boundary result cannot close normal-launch or combined runtime proof. Preserve SDK-disabled versus retained propagation and separate bridge flags. Allocate promised exporter/activation modes per signal, including absent/empty, none/other and protocol branches where promised and reachable; logs-only opt-out cannot prove trace/metric selectors. Keep the planned repair consistent with acceptance: supporting a transport and rejecting it are different outcomes. No unselected exporter installation is required.

Prove normal-launcher operator/identity variants, rather than inferring them from helpers. Same-path conjunctions require joint proof. Separate focused SDK/bridge/receiver, app-test and normal-runtime boundaries under consistent scenario IDs; scalar proof levels cover every constituent assertion, and either requires adequate alternatives for the same contract. Never borrow another control's strongest mode/visibility. Direct instrumentation without an audit retains concrete selected future controls. Judge actual omissions/overclaims, not chronology, row count or constant finalizer syntax alone. For promised optional modes resolve actual named activation or a supported default. Follow the exact selected overload and terminal native/container conversion. Reconcile text finding/control IDs and every promised carrier/metadata field to its actual owner and predicate; known IDs and general propagation paragraphs alone are insufficient. Preserve valid operator signal-specific local log headers through official SDK parsing, without empty overrides; a generic-header conflict must remain distinct and isolated to the added local log path. Bind a catalog of selected source operations and promised outcomes to predicates, parameters, outputs/lifecycle phases and asserting scenarios. A shared global scan or complete parameterization is valid when its capture scope and witnesses of every selected operation are explicit; literal operation-name matches and duplicated tests are not required. A broad statement that all captured records are covered is not an operation/phase witness. Keep unmapped bindings open. Bind privacy trails to the logging finding they prove; another record's pass or a general test list cannot allocate its fields. For application-owned SDK-disabled guards, verify selected propagation setup remains reachable and test carrier extraction through that same disabled init path; provider registration alone cannot prove it. For selected application fallback promises, bind named inputs to the actual caller's fallback value/tuple and winning owner; testing a shared helper with different defaults does not prove initialization. Preserve required empty/absent/malformed and both-absent controls. Source-only delegated defaults do not select runtime permutations. A related launch can witness an absent-setting case when its effective inputs and actual assertions are retained; require neither a literal case name nor duplicate execution. Resolve actual configuration ownership before adding readers: a supporting SDK can consume environment settings without application parsers or explicit options. Reconcile justified application overrides and their precedence/outcomes as well as bound audit controls; do not impose unused SDK-reader suites. Check each independently selectable finding's acceptance closure from the changes and producers its actual assertions consume, not only declared IDs: its owner and transitive prerequisites must supply them, including other-signal producers required by a control. Request/worker/log integration belongs to the finding owning the whole path; a repair owned only by a dependent or unselected finding is unavailable. Group coupled activation/producer repairs when no independently deliverable contract exists, without cycles or dropping invariants. Preserve established audit/selection IDs and obligations; genuinely unselected extra claims need not be added to a new contract, but established, critical and operator requirements cannot be withdrawn to avoid their tests. For explicitly selected/configured composite propagation, assert each promised component's carrier state at the claimed boundary; TraceContext alone does not prove Baggage, and propagation does not authorize baggage capture into logs. Distinguish preserving environment bytes from effective policy: an intentional programmatic override can be valid when authority, precedence and inactive controls are explicit, but contradictory effective-preservation promises cannot pass. A selected exporter gate for a value other than OTLP needs a control proving no added local OTLP pipeline and preserved native output, without forcing an unselected exporter installation; naming unchanged inactive SDK settings alone selects no parser suite. Reconcile selected configuration controls against the actual child environment and active launch/profile inputs; an asserted absent key contradicted by those inputs is a defect, and every promised rejection needs an allocated assertion.

Identifies actual native logging,SDK/agent/provider/bridge ownership and startup reachability. Uses one supported owner per record,retains original sinks and does not infer a working pipeline from environment variables alone.

Preserves record semantics:actual WARN mapping,source occurrence versus observed time,bounded useful bodies and supported structured values. Does not invent mandatory EventName,exception payloads or unsupported SDK capabilities. Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.

Requires or proves canonical log TraceId and SpanId joins to exact real SDK spans,with parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Ordinary attributes,nonempty IDs,shared TraceId or stdout correlation alone are insufficient. Derive the expected SpanId from the actual bridge/API-selected context, including supported caller-side capture when used. A framework INTERNAL child is valid with the correct verified request ancestry; an unsupported SERVER-only expectation is not. Do not remove legitimate layer spans or overwrite valid context solely to satisfy an invented topology. For cross-process correlation, assess the actual peer carrier and installed propagator capability before assigning a logger/context repair. Preserve emitted flags and runtime constraints; report an unsupported peer feature honestly rather than stripping flags, manually copying IDs or silently raising the runtime floor. A supported-stack positive workflow still requires its real end-to-end join. Rejection of a valid peer carrier remains a propagator dependency conformance gap; do not relabel it optional covered behavior or treat an unsupported report as a successful join.

Addresses the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right request pairing. Reuses verified Java/Node propagation;identifies or repairs missing Go request-context and Python executor propagation. Separate sync and async probes cannot prove the same worker-to-real-span path. Scope error/cancellation controls to existing owned behavior or clearly labeled supported SDK probes. Do not require a new business cancellation feature on an app with no such path; ending a span or detaching context cannot be counted as canceling scheduled work. Preserve all controls already required by the bound contract, executing them or retaining them as not proven. A selected reuse probe must exercise the same execution unit with distinct work-item contexts and context-free work; fresh concurrent workers sharing one context do not prove that reuse or request isolation. A missing-transfer probe must omit transfer on the selected handoff path; a direct outside-context emit is a different control. Preserve caller detach/restore. Do not add business worker behavior merely for an optional focused capability probe, or remove a focused probe already bound.

Distinguishes legitimate outside-span/unsampled context from broken wiring. No stale request IDs on startup logs,no fabricated spans/forced sampling,and explicit uncertainty for unexecuted cases. For an exact unsampled claim, compare canonical IDs/flags to independently observed SDK context selected by the logging/bridge API for that record and claimed boundary, including explicit context or caller-side capture. Do not substitute the ambient context of a later queue/export worker. Matching trace, nonempty SpanId or two agreeing logs cannot establish the expected request SpanId. Do not require exported unsampled spans or production identifier fields. Audit chooses a supported observation/mode before binding; a focused oracle cannot later close a bound full-runtime exact-value claim.

Applies source-backed privacy and exception scope without introducing raw request IDs,unbounded errors or unsupported alias requirements. Bounded left/right categories are permitted;ordinary native messages do not require instrumentation-only exception events. When a selected privacy probe exposes framework/access/error renderer content captured by the path, do not defer it merely as dependency-owned. Preserve permitted diagnostic category, effective level, sinks and application behavior while removing policy-forbidden values at the policy-selected boundary; blanket suppression is not redaction. Inspect a supported native hook or explicitly leave a genuinely unsupported boundary unresolved, then rerun the actual failing probe in native and OTLP output. Inspect all framework records captured by the selected bridge, not only a fixed-message/application-logger allowlist; separately routed SDK diagnostics retain their own boundary. For each selected negative trigger, resolve its actual handled or escaping error branch and producer before choosing a repair or source-supported no-action disposition. Same-endpoint rejection and unhandled failure need not share a producer or hook. A retained source file or trail template alone does not resolve that mechanism. For unresolved capability, name the exact source symbol/event/API edge, owner and next inspection/probe observation that distinguishes supported repair from an unsupported boundary. Retain a source-bound producer/call-site → native event → supported policy-boundary hook/action → later renderers → native/SDK outputs trail, with sentinel-absence AND permitted-category assertions at each covered output. For asserted event order, distinguish registration/enqueue from actual callback invocation and completion relative to synchronous work and teardown, using establishing source or supported ordering evidence. A deferred callback can run after response/socket teardown yet before SDK/writer capture; require the actual selected policy boundary, not an invented earlier lifecycle point. An unachievable required boundary remains a gap. A deny-only hook cannot preserve a required category. An unresolved producer/event/API edge needs its owner and exact next source/probe check, not a generic formatter assessment. Apply shared record predicates through explicit operation bindings or the complete shared/global scan or parameterization with covered outputs, phases and operation witnesses accepted by criterion2. A native producer investigation needs the matching dependency implementation/public API/artifact or permitted bytecode receipt and inspected symbol, or an exact unavailable artifact/edge and discriminating next observation. SDK mapper/autoconfiguration code and dependency/POM metadata alone do not establish that native producer path. Prioritizing this work is guidance, not a required tool-call chronology; equivalent complete evidence remains valid.

Assess effective selected log-attribute count/value limits or unlimited behavior, defaults, precedence and construction cost. Resolve the actual startup-to-provider/bridge configuration and enforcement needed for selected outcomes or exact claims; explicit processors or public options alone do not establish forwarding or bypass. Follow claimed normalization and diagnostic delegates, including accessible source before installation. Ordinary delegated SDK defaults need no exhaustive unused-setting/permutation suite; retain versioned ownership/default or scoped unsupported/unverified evidence without claiming runtime proof.

Distinguish strings/characters from byte arrays, recursive array/map value limits from top-level attribute count, depth counting/replacement from unsupported depth, and actual discard/eviction/drop accounting. Preserve selected model-specific/general fallback and programmatic precedence. Exercise below/at/above selected bounds, supplied/changed settings and expressly claimed supported shapes/cadence. Direct SDK emission cannot prove a separately selected native logger/handler/appender path; retain bridge-added attributes and drop accounting. A source option or successful truncation cannot establish diagnostic cadence.

Common limit diagnostics MAY be emitted, but truncation/discard/replacement diagnostics MUST occur at most once per affected record; preserve the separate Logs SDK discard-diagnostic SHOULD. Resolve relevant emission paths/once guards. First establish a limit-induced record-data change: invalid-key/uniqueness messages and configuration warnings returning unchanged values do not automatically count as limit diagnostics. Separate source-known guards/no-emission facts from executed cadence proof and retain real upstream limitations.

Keep Body/privacy policy distinct from attribute limits and Resource exemptions; span limits do not configure log limits. Guard actually expensive selected construction with supported enablement checks and prove disabled/filter/opt-out avoids that work. Do not impose expensive guards on cheap fixed messages, arbitrary Body caps, fabricated capture paths, duplicate suppression/providers, SDK replacement or forced upgrades. Unsupported/development features remain explicit; unverified defaults cannot close selected privacy, safe-cost or operator-limit invariants. For an explicit absence/cadence claim, follow helper return decisions through caller state updates and terminal aggregation/diagnostic guards. A helper with no warning cannot prove the record pipeline has no diagnostic; source calls and once guards do not themselves prove configured-level/sink visibility. Keep bounded inspected scope and unknowns accurate, and reject a source-resolvable false claim even if the report disclaims an upstream conformance suite or app repair.

Identify actual batch/exporter/lifecycle owners. Separate native calls, enqueue, attempts, received copies, acknowledged accepted, rejected, dropped, unknown and persistence; healthy one-per-call receipts differ from retries. Derive test success and visibility separately for each signal and phase: an expected fault with zero received logs may pass its assertions but cannot claim log otlp_accepted, and healthy traces/metrics cannot supply that log visibility. Retain accurate non-receipt/unproven states and counts. Audit plans selected controls; runtime claims require current execution.

Decode each request's N and match batches/attempts to actual client terminal outcomes before totals. Conforming HTTP200 with the selected ExportLogsServiceResponse encoding and partial_success unset acknowledges N accepted/0 rejected. Populated partial with R rejected acknowledges N-R/R; warning-only R=0 acknowledges N/0. Both populated cases MUST NOT retry. When protocol response classification is selected or claimed, preserve concrete full/partial/warning assertions even when future-only or direct instrumentation lacks an audit. Otherwise retain accurate delegated capability/ownership without selecting a protocol conformance suite merely by using OTLP. Invalid/unrelated200 bodies do not establish conformance. Unknown acceptance remains legitimate for unresolved negative/size failures; acknowledgement, record identity and persistence stay separate.

Distinguish completed negative responses from stalls using client/receiver evidence, not server intent, null counts or aggregate elapsed time. Retain per-outcome counts/raw links, request fingerprints, attempt timestamps and measured waits when selected; mixed failures cannot inherit unqualified otlp_accepted visibility. Use a retry-capable policy and positive retryable-response control to prove non-retry classification; disabled/exhausted retries prove neither. HTTP429/502/503/504 SHOULD retry; other4xx/5xx MUST NOT. Preserve operator retry policy, throttling representation/conditions, no early retry beyond remaining budget, separate recovery from exhaustion, and independently selected direct-export, processor, cancellation and persistent-failure controls.

Trace exact deadline claims through real creation, propagation, waits/retries and consumption. Distinguish serialized assignments, units, effective defaults/fallbacks, configured/per-attempt/whole-export budgets and measured durations. An after-failure elapsed check is not necessarily a strict ceiling; retain overshoot and earlier enclosing cancellation. Process/shutdown time cannot prove batch deadlines. Preserve selected processor Export synchronization without duplicate app locking or confusion with exporter request concurrency.

Prove selected final-record drain through normal launch and the configured application path. For a selected shutdown-drain claim, identify a genuine queued/pending record at the selected provider-drain boundary of the application stop sequence (possibly after finalizer logging), with its effective queue/schedule/batch conditions and observation. A pre-stop emit might already have exported; a held receiver response may show only an in-flight export. Neither alone proves pending-record drain. Prove that record's own receipt attributable to shutdown before actual SDK-child exit: for example, exact decoded receiver/Studio observation followed by verified child liveness, or a bound raw-record → conforming acknowledgement → actually awaited shutdown causal chain retaining the client outcome. An owned receiver's receipt/ack event is another option, not a required product field. ObservedTimestamp may come from the SDK at emission and be preserved; do not assume it is the selected receiver's ingestion clock or use it alone for receipt/exit order. After-exit queries, nil shutdown results, exit zero or launcher wait timing alone cannot prove that order; reconcile ignored shutdown errors and actual child lifetime. Retain selected settings/authority and honest proof scope without arbitrary tuning. Reuse a real application operation/log where possible; no new production log solely for a test. Assert per-body/identity multiplicities, body/severity, expected Resource, both trace and span IDs or their required absence, and the same stop cycle's time window. An aggregate count can hide one missing record plus a duplicate; unrelated healthy joins, focused export, live snapshots, opt-out or cleanup cannot substitute. Reconcile effective launcher signal ownership. For selected repeated-stop controls, resolve effective handler registration/removal and default fallback after the first request. Deliver the specified second request to the same process during active final logging/provider drain; retain event order, actual outcome and budget without imposing unselected request combinations. A selected uninterrupted-drain policy requires non-interruption and once-only finalization; policy-permitted forced termination follows its separate control.

Retain transport-limit clauses and ownership only when selected under criterion14; ordinary delegated HTTP use alone does not select them. Require concrete selected application/claimed-guarantee controls; truthful delegated-default/external dispositions do not require exhaustive upstream receiver certification. No unresolved external capability closes a critical application delivery/safety invariant. Never add custom app parsers/retries merely to expose SDK internals. For fixtures with the documented Graceful-stop contract in README.md, this is application policy, not an OTel signal-handler requirement. Account for every received request, not only the final snapshot; retain terminal outcomes for partial/warning trials. SDK success alone cannot prove response-body decoding. During instrumentation, safely executable selected final-drain proof remains required work unless genuinely blocked. A selected stop plan names request kind, recipient and launcher→effective application handler/finalizer path, expected outcome, budget/source, observable order and its own final-record predicate. A selected retry trial names a source-supported retryable response/connection event, batch/trial identity, existing SDK policy/wait source, remaining budget, measured wait/range and terminal outcome. Existing SDK backoff/jitter is sufficient when selected; server throttling is not automatically required. Distinguish failed-batch recovery from only later healthy batches; prove the actual claimed scope and persistent failure ending by its deadline/eligibility rule. A generic immediate-failure/stall label is not a retry stimulus. Keep permitted forced-repeat and uninterrupted-drain outcomes separate; force cannot establish graceful drain or imply final-record receipt. Retain independently observed receipts accurately; source-proven interruption of required drain needs repair. Different decoded record sets alone do not establish retry lineage. Retain unmatched batch client outcomes as unknown; do not assign server intent or another export's deadline result. Unknown acceptance or no observed acknowledgement cannot support unqualified log otlp_accepted, while a known completed client error remains completed. A valid shared final-record predicate must actually run against that final record/phase with its own context and time interval; another healthy trial cannot supply it.

Checks applicable diagnostic routing and configured-signal isolation. Audit allocates a feasible observation boundary; claimed application fault/isolation proof must exercise the actual initializer, production provider/processor path (including batching when selected), bridge and application operations. A supported instance-local transport/exporter seam may establish app_test scope; SDK-only substitutes do not prove this conjunction. Retain actual log failure responses/client outcomes, capture the actual native diagnostic owner rather than replacing it with a counting handler, and decode each other configured signal's actual receipts from its owning producers. An enabled but untested pipeline cannot be labelled `not configured`. Keep normal-launch proof separate and do not downgrade a bound full-runtime control. Preserve production guards/shared receivers without redirecting them or intercepting global transports. Source review or healthy traffic does not establish an outage test;unexecuted fault/optional SDK cases remain explicitly unproven instead of fabricated passes. Match only the fault/operation combinations actually selected by the bound contract to their own native output, diagnostics, progress and unrelated-signal receipts. A one-operation stall cannot cover a selected refusal or another required operation; do not invent an unselected cross-product. Keep unexecuted combinations open while retaining independently proven direct item scope. Derive this fault verdict from its own selected contract; a separate stop-control gap is relevant only when it prevents a necessary fault/isolation predicate or prerequisite.

Uses fresh source/command/dependency-bound evidence with actual outcome counts and retained failures. Honors required project runtime and configured local endpoints. A copied old receipt,stale source or zero exit without execution cannot establish current verification. Resolve saved local execution-evidence references to existing retained artifacts. Report trace_ids from that specific scenario operation/receipt or leave them empty when unproven; copying the first IDs from a different request into every row is inaccurate even when the source trial passed. Verify effective runner CLI/environment precedence in proposed and executed profiles. FLASK_RUN_RELOAD=false does not override an explicit --reload in make dev. A no-reload claim requires a supported effective flag/configuration; otherwise scope evidence to the actual reload worker and process-group cleanup. Preserve existing reload policy unless selected for change; environment text alone cannot prove single-process startup. Retain distinct trial storage on the actual filesystem: case-only names may refer to one overwritten file. Check each retained result input/case identity against the claimed trial; two case aliases cannot establish separate true/TRUE controls.

Preserves application routes,behavior,operator identity and original sinks;keeps local logs local and makes no unrequested SDK upgrades,cloud configuration or unrelated business instrumentation. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity. When service.version or another resource field is explicitly promised, require its source-backed expected value and preservation assertion at the declared boundary; name/environment-only checks do not close it. Genuinely unavailable/unpromised optional version metadata remains absent, not invented. For normal-launch identity variants, construct the actual child environment with conflicting inherited keys removed, account for active loader/profile inputs, and inspect the received Resource. For selected endpoint/header/activation policy, resolve the actual highest-priority supported input, including programmatic/file/loader inputs and launcher/build-tool child-VM properties where applicable. A conflicting value at that winning input needs effective destination, credential-boundary, activation and independent-signal preservation assertions at the selected boundary; environment-only checks cannot prove a policy another layer overrides. Use the existing SDK/configuration owner without a new parser or silent operator-policy override; retain an exact unresolved boundary where necessary. An inherited explicit service name cannot establish a resource-only or absent-identity trial.

Reconcile primary logging clauses needed for selected application behavior, supplied operator policy, app-owned or changed configuration, source-backed risks and actual capability claims in the normal canonical report by source/version/date, conditions, requirement strength, maturity, owner, capability/disposition and proof boundary. Exact normative/conformance claims retain exact clause bindings. Unchanged delegated SDK/receiver duties may use compact versioned source/default/unsupported/unverified dispositions without reproducing every imported clause or selecting tests of unselected inputs, shapes or features. This never closes a missing selected application invariant or an unproven runtime claim. The exhaustive OTel guidance inventory and source-to-skill clause review are PR-level maintenance acceptance, not a deliverable repeated by every bare application workflow. Retain distinct recommendations, permissions and mandatory fallbacks, including normative imports and compatibility qualifications. For precise normative/conformance claims, bounded retained excerpts or exact immutable-audit evidence-row references may carry unchanged clauses; generic URLs, nearby SDK comments or topic summaries cannot establish those claims. Unchanged delegated defaults may use compact versioned source/ownership/limitation evidence without a per-service sibling-clause ledger. Refresh current capabilities/outcomes after installation/probes without inheriting old runtime success.

Allocate duties to the actual SDK, bridge, instrumentation/semantic-convention author, application, receiver or operator. Supported SDK defaults need no duplicate application implementation. Apply criterion2's configuration scope: every selected app/operator promise and actual capability claim needs adequate evidence; unused upstream settings/permutations need no exhaustive inventory/conformance suite. Unselected sibling SDK/receiver duties require no per-service clause ledger. Use scoped source/default/unsupported/unverified facts where needed to explain selected behavior, with unknown effects and conditional resolution steps. These dispositions never establish unproven runtime behavior or close critical selected invariants. Do not retrospectively remove promises or pass current outputs.

Before requiring a transport-bound entry, identify the selecting app-owned/changed bound, supplied operator policy, source-backed size/decompression risk or precise related capability/conformance claim. Ordinary delegated HTTP export, endpoint/timeout setup or an acknowledged status/body limitation alone does not select every sibling size/decompression duty. For actually selected duties retain only the necessary separate receiver request-bound/decompression MUST/413, exporter request-bound SHOULD/no-send-above-active-bound MUST/discard SHOULD, client response-bound/decompression MUST/non-retryable-oversize MUST/discard SHOULD, and receiver response-bound MUST clauses. Preserve oversized partial-response reduction SHOULD when possible/practical, optional diagnostic trimming MAY, still-oversize500 MUST with unspecified acceptance, configurability SHOULD and recommended—not mandatory application—64MiB/4MiB values. Use corresponding gRPC clauses when selected. An externally owned receiver needs accurate owner/disposition, not certification as an ordinary app prerequisite; actual receiver conformance/implementation claims require evidence at that receiver, not a synthetic substitute.

Read concrete repairs and exact claims against actual public APIs, constructor/options/units, startup/configuration precedence and consuming enforcement, including parser/normalizer/diagnostic/default/retry delegates. Documentation alone, an unused helper or Not run label cannot substantiate a source-resolvable exact claim; retain contradictions honestly. Scoped probes establish their actual boundary. Preserve private-extension applicability rather than imposing unrelated standard defaults. Do not impose arbitrary tuning, framework recipes, SDK rewrites/upgrades or application fixes for upstream-owned limitations. Reconcile retained primary and imported sources to exact bound sections, preserving implication direction. For selected processor behavior, a source-backed risk or an actual processor-conformance claim, retain the applicable SDK-owned OnEmit synchrony/nonblocking/nonthrowing, independent-filtering and mutation-visibility dispositions. Assess independent OnEmit filtering when the selected processor filters and supports Enabled, or wraps a filtering processor; a default LoggerConfig claim alone does not select those sibling duties. Otherwise compact unchanged SDK/default source and ownership evidence suffices, without a per-service sibling-clause ledger. Preserve the full clause-to-skill inventory for requested maintenance. Keep source-known response defaults/status/body handling separate from unresolved adapters/runtime, without demanding unrelated upstream certification. Qualify selected maturity separately for the normative specification and actual installed/proposed component/API. A stable data model cannot establish SDK/bridge stability, and a source comment about one component cannot establish the whole language is beta. Keep absent/uninspected status honest without forced upgrades. Read and retain the actual primary slice before making a selected normative or precise specification-revision claim; bind it to the cited heading, subject, operation, conditions, strength and action. A remembered revision, correct file with an unrelated range, topic URL or SDK implementation alone cannot substantiate it. A sourced URL/date suffices when no precise revision is established; ordinary delegated source facts still need no clause ledger. For a selected application-owned callback, bind its actual operation contract, owner/actions and assertion or exact limitation. A custom OnEmit plan must reconcile synchronous emitting-thread execution, nonblocking/nonthrowing SHOULD and directly registered mutation-visibility MUST separately; synchrony alone does not prove the recommendations. Do not impose callback inventories on unchanged unselected SDK components. Bind each exact capability/default/absence claim to its concrete declaring symbol and terminal consuming implementation; a broader interface signature or a different reader's sentinel/default cannot establish that concrete path. Separate internal SDK diagnostic logging from public error-handler routing where those routes differ. For a newly owned global bridge, preserve existing custom/strict error-handler authority and prove an independent error route before provider/bridge activation; an existing safe route needs no replacement. Do not treat a returned global delegator as a historical native-handler snapshot.

For selected new names preserve valid-Unicode MUST and lowercase/dot/snake SHOULD plus established-concatenation-over-underscore SHOULD with ecosystem evidence (not an individual API/SDK spelling alone) and compatibility. Optional log.iostream uses an applicable known value (MUST); custom otherwise MAY. Preserve the log.record.original conditional permission for a string-like original AND differing Body without inventing a converse prohibition. Formal Development semantic-event definitions MUST NOT prescribe ObservedTimestamp/SeverityText and may define Body only as a string display message; this does not forbid SDK-populated fields or structured ordinary log Body. For selected standard-exporter retry claims retain the transient-error exponential-backoff-and-jitter MUST with whole-export/earlier-caller budgets; do not add app retry loops, arbitrary tuning or unrelated conformance suites.
